tool_args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original adult humanoid FRONT DESIGN REFERENCE, source-only, for a tabletop game helper. One image, one character, one front view.
Reference roles: the previously inspected Luke Cage owner reference informs only the cohort's substantial miniature proportions, warm ochre color relationship and material readability. The inspected Medusa quality reference informs sculptural finish and clear materials only. Create a new female identity and a distinct investigator costume; copy neither reference's face, anatomy, headgear, chains, costume, weapons or pose.

Subject: an ORIGINAL adult African-American female field investigator, approximately 35 years old, athletic practical proportions, medium natural black curly hair, a distinctive original face with broad cheekbones and a calm alert expression, looking straight forward. No actor resemblance. Practical deep-russet leather jacket worn open over an ochre knit top, fitted charcoal dark trousers, sturdy dark leather ankle boots. Plain utilitarian seams and small unbranded fasteners. No headgear; show the entire hair silhouette.

Identity and sides are critical: her anatomical RIGHT forearm and RIGHT hand (on the VIEWER'S LEFT) are bronze mechanical prosthetics, exposed below a jacket sleeve rolled to the elbow. Show articulated forearm plates, a clear wrist and five distinct mechanically jointed digits, relaxed and gently separated beside her torso. Her anatomical LEFT arm and hand (on the VIEWER'S RIGHT) are natural dark-brown human skin. Her natural LEFT hand holds one small plain unbranded compact pistol pointed straight DOWN, with index finger resting outside the trigger guard; show the hand and grip clearly. No second pistol. No glow or energy in the bionic arm.

Pose: relaxed upright neutral stance. Shoulders level and square to the camera, chest, pelvis, knees, both boots and face straight forward, no twist or three-quarter view. Both elbows mildly bent in a natural relaxed pose, forearms slightly away from the torso. Clear charcoal-background gaps around both arms, between each hand/weapon and the thighs, and between the legs. Both hands fully visible and readable, unobstructed by jacket or thighs. Feet comfortably separated and planted on the same single pedestal.

Composition: STRICT FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC elevation with parallel projection, no perspective convergence and no view down onto the pedestal. Portrait 2:3 canvas. Entire figure, hair, hands, pistol, boots and entire pedestal inside the frame. The highest curl begins at 6 percent of canvas height, leaving a clean 6 percent top margin. The BOTTOM edge of the pedestal is at exactly 90 percent of canvas height, leaving 10 percent empty background below. Center the figure with generous side margins. One round dark stone pedestal composed of exactly TWO low stacked discs of subtly different diameter, one integrated base. Render it EXACTLY EDGE-ON: only straight horizontal front bands and their sides, zero visible top plane, no ellipse, no sloping oval lip, no extra plinth, no second base.

Style and materials: polished high-quality collectible miniature design render, original stylized realism with a sculpted adult face, readable curls, convincing worn russet leather, woven ochre knit, matte dark cloth, boots and satin aged bronze joints. Restrained wear, clean silhouette and clear material separation. Soft neutral studio illumination from the front and sides, gentle modeling, no dramatic rim glow. Plain uniform charcoal background all the way to the image edges. The figure and pedestal alone, no ground plane, no scene, no cast backdrop shape, no atmospheric effect.

Constraints: no VFX, no spark, no muzzle flash, no smoke, no glow, no scenic objects, no text, no lettering, no logo, no insignia, no watermark, no UI, no diagram arrows, no labels, no inset or alternate views. Do not imitate franchise key art, an actor, a commercial scan or the owner's costume. This is a single original design reference image.
